entries.scope: One-command storage cleanup, public wrappers, non-MSL adapters, TUI, and evidence contract
entries.rationale: The public maintenance command gains a default safe cleanup stage, new profiles, a deep confirmation boundary, and repository-specific safety behavior that operators and agents must understand.
entries.navigationImpact: The maintenance portals and both root entry pages link the new storage behavior and manpage.
entries.languageStrategy: German first with synchronized English partner content; public PowerShell help and CLI output are bilingual.
entries.platformAndExampleProof: Bash check-only ran on macOS against the live Level-2 registry; PowerShell parser validation, shared Python tests, and 69 cross-platform TUI contract tests cover the equivalent Windows argument path.
entries.risk: Unsafe cleanup documentation could cause loss of build evidence; the documented path, Git, profile, process, container, and non-MSL gates match executable policy.
entries.reevaluationTrigger: A retention threshold, provider command, supported adapter, protected artifact class, profile default, or deletion proof changes.

entries.rationale: The new public Bash and PowerShell entrypoints must appear in the deterministic script reference.
entries.navigationImpact: The existing script-reference link now resolves the storage maintainer in the maintenance category.
entries.languageStrategy: The renderer derives bilingual descriptions from public script help.
entries.platformAndExampleProof: The renderer validates both .sh and .ps1 entrypoints before replacing the generated block.
entries.reevaluationTrigger: A public script entrypoint or catalog mapping changes.

entries.rationale: The completed feature adds a required phase slot and update-log entry to the repository statistics contract.
entries.navigationImpact: No new navigation path; the existing statistics ledger gains phase slot 64.
entries.languageStrategy: The update log and generated text alternatives remain German first and English second.
entries.platformAndExampleProof: The canonical PowerShell renderer was invoked through the macOS Bash entrypoint and check-only reported CURRENT.
entries.reevaluationTrigger: Another completed feature or implementation phase changes the ledger.
